content.title: Barcelona vs Rayo Vallecano - as it happened
content.text: Barcelona vs Rayo Vallecano, matchday 29, La Liga 2025/26, 22/03/2026, starting lineups. BeSoccer Join us for LIVE coverage of the La Liga matchday 29 fixture between Barcelona and Rayo Vallecano, kick-off at 14.00 CET, at Camp Nou in Barcelona, Spain. List of goalscorers 24' 1 - 0 Match report in news End of match 90+6' FT (1-0): Barcelona edged a tightly contested Sunday clash at the Camp Nou with a 1-0 win, settled by Ronald Araujo's decisive finish from a corner. Thank you for joining us and see you soon! 90' Six minutes added! Substitution at FC Barcelona 90' Barcelona sub: Cancelo is replaced by Espart. 89' Isi Palazon is booked. 84' Rayo Vallecano sub: Fran Perez is replaced by Camello. 83' Barcelona sub: Yamal is replaced by Rashford. 80' Gerard Martin goes to ground expecting a free kick, appealing as he falls under pressure. Instead, Cordero Vega spots a handball from the Barcelona defender during the action and awards the decision the other way. 78' The contest remains delicately balanced, with Barcelona not fully in control but staying alert and disciplined. Rayo continue to threaten and look very much in it, giving the sense they are still capable of taking something away from the Camp Nou. 75' There is a short pause in play as whistles from the stands create confusion on the pitch. With sounds echoing beyond the referee's own, the officials take a moment to settle things before allowing the match to continue. 73' Pau Cubarsi is shown a yellow card after arriving just too late on Isi Palazon. The Barcelona centre-back misjudges the timing and catches his man, leaving the referee with a straightforward decision. 68' Rayo pick up another caution, this time for Pathe Ciss after he brings down Lamine Yamal just as the winger looks to break through on goal. It is a clear tactical foul, and the yellow card means Ciss will be suspended for the next match against Elche. 65' Fran Perez goes into the referee's notebook after a forceful tackle on Joao Cancelo. The challenge is firm and mistimed, leaving the official with little choice but to show the yellow card. 62' Barcelona double sub: Bernal and Fermin Lopez OUT. Casado and Olmo IN. 60' Rayo Vallecano double sub: Diaz and Gumbau OUT. De Frutos and Lopez IN. 59' Ferran finds space with a sharp run and gets the better of Ciss, opening up the angle for a low strike across goal. The effort is drifting just wide of Batalla's right post, and Raphinha throws himself in to try and turn it home, but he cannot quite get there in time! 57' Lamine Yamal responds immediately, collecting the ball on the edge of the area and driving forward with real purpose. He opens his body and aims across goal, but the effort drifts wide of the far post, just missing the target! 55' It has been a quiet outing for Lamine Yamal so far, with little going his way in attack. This time, Chavarria steps in with ease, taking the ball off him without much resistance and underlining a frustrating spell for the winger. 52' Fermin Lopez is down on the turf, holding his left thigh, clearly feeling discomfort in the quadriceps. There is a brief moment of concern, but he quickly regains his feet and appears ready to continue without any real issue. 50' Fermin swings a cross into the area with Lewandowski lurking, ready to pounce, but Pathe Ciss reads it well and gets there first. The Rayo midfielder clears decisively, cutting out the danger before it can develop. 48' Rayo carve an opening with a sharp through ball towards Fran Perez, who nudges it on into the path of Alvaro Garcia. It looks dangerous for a moment, but Joan Garcia reads it perfectly and rushes off his line to claim it inside the box. The flag goes up shortly after for offside, bringing the move to an end. Substitution at FC Barcelona Substitution at Rayo Vallecano Substitution at Rayo Vallecano 46' Rayo Vallecano double sub: Martin and Valentin OUT. Garcia Rivera and Espino IN. 46' Barcelona sub: Robert Lewandowski is replaced by Ferran Torres. 46' The second half gets underway with three changes made overall. 45+3' HT (1-0): Barcelona controlled the first half after an early scare, with Joan Garcia and Batalla both producing key saves to keep the score level for long spells. Araujo eventually broke the deadlock from a corner, while Raphinha missed a clear chance and Rayo faded after a strong defensive start. We'll see what happens next! 45' Three minutes added! 42' Ratiu looks to break in behind and suddenly there is danger for Barcelona, but Pau Cubarsi reads it brilliantly. The young defender steps across at just the right moment and produces a clean, decisive tackle to shut the move down. The reaction from the crowd says it all: a well-deserved round of applause for the player. 40' The rhythm of the match has eased in the last few minutes, with Barcelona no longer pressing with the same intensity. Rayo enjoy a bit more possession, but struggle to break through, finding no real spaces to exploit. Whenever Barca lose the ball, they quickly settle into a solid defensive shape, keeping everything under control. 37' And now it is Rayo asking the question. Ratiu drives into the box and slips past Fermin, then goes down under pressure, appealing straight away for a penalty. The full back insists there was contact as the Barcelona player left a leg out, but Cordero Vega is not interested and gestures for play to continue. 34' Oscar Valentin is the latest name to go into the book, with the referee stepping in to halt play and issue a yellow card. It is a sign that tensions are beginning to rise as the contest grows more intense. 26' Lamine Yamal goes into the referee's notebook after a moment of frustration. Pathe Ciss nicks the ball away as the winger tries to carry it forward, and Yamal leaves a leg in on the follow-through. The challenge is enough for the referee to stop play and issue a yellow card. Goaaaaaal! de FC Barcelona en el 24' Statistics of Ronald Araujo in Primera División 18 3 0.17 0 2 0 24' GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAALLLL FOR BARCELONA! Barcelona have their breakthrough and it comes from a set piece, with Ronald Araujo rising to the moment. Cancelo curls the corner towards the far post, and the Uruguayan is perfectly positioned, striking through the ball with a low, dipping effort that clips the post on its way in. Batalla is left rooted, with no chance of keeping it out as Barcelona take the lead! 21' There is a moment of worry as Joan Garcia goes down and signals discomfort, especially after all the noise earlier in the week, suggesting there was no real injury. Szczesny even begins to get himself ready on the touchline, just in case. In the end, though, it appears the goalkeeper will carry on, much to Barcelona's relief. 19' Lamine Yamal darts into the box and skips past Pathe Ciss with quick feet, then goes to ground under pressure, immediately appealing for a penalty. Cordero Vega is unmoved and signals play on without hesitation, and from the live angle, it looks like the right call. No intervention from VAR either, so the game continues. 16' Barcelona are now setting the tempo and dictating proceedings, moving the ball with authority and purpose. Rayo, so solid in the early stages, are starting to lose their grip on the contest, their defensive shape slipping after the costly error from Ciss. The momentum has clearly swung in favour of the hosts. 14' Out of nothing, Barcelona are handed a huge opportunity as Pathe Ciss makes a dreadful mistake, gifting possession in a dangerous area. Raphinha pounces and drives into the box with barely a challenge in sight, while Batalla rushes out to narrow the angle. It looks set for the opener, but the Brazilian gets it all wrong, dragging his right-footed effort wide of the post. A massive let off for Rayo and easily the best chance of the match so far. 12' Joao Cancelo charges down the right and makes it all the way to the byline, creating a real opening for Barcelona. The final ball lets him down completely, overhit and drifting harmlessly out of play. Rayo restart with a goal kick. 10' Barcelona finally register their first effort on target, sparked by a confident piece of play from Gerard Martin. The youngster shifts the ball neatly onto his left foot on the edge of the area and lets fly, but it lacks the venom to trouble Batalla, who gathers with ease and keeps things under control. 8' Raphinha's name is taken as the referee shows no hesitation, penalising a robust tackle on Lejeune. The Brazilian flies in with real force, catching his opponent and leaving the official with little choice. Interestingly, Raphinha gestures that there was no complaint from Lejeune himself, but the decision is already made. 5' Pedri takes possession deep inside his own half and, in one silky motion, spins away from danger with trademark elegance. Valentin is left trailing, chasing shadows as the Barcelona midfielder surges forward with purpose. Spotting Raphinha ahead, he attempts to slide the move into the Brazilian's path, but the chance fizzles out as the control lets him down at the crucial moment! 4' A reflex save of the highest order, sharp, commanding and absolutely vital to keep Barcelona level in the opening moments. 3' Out of nowhere, Rayo Vallecano burst into life with their very first foray forward, and it nearly caught Barcelona cold. Chavarria slips in behind Araujo with real intent, delivers a perfectly weighted pass into the path of Carlos Martin, and it looks destined for the net until Joan produces a magnificent stop! 1' Barcelona get us going in blue and red from left to right, while Rayo Vallecano are in white! Start of match PRVW Rayo Vallecano starting XI: Batalla (GK); Ratiu, Lejeune, Ciss, Chavarria; Valentin, Diaz, Gumbau; Martin, Palazon and Perez. PRVW Barcelona starting XI: Joan Garcia (GK); Cancelo, Martin, Cubarsi, Araujo; Pedri, Bernal, Lopez; Raphinha, Lewandowski and Yamal. PRVW Cordero Vega will take charge on the pitch for this one, with Gonzalez Frances serving as the VAR. PRVW Rayo Vallecano possible lineup: Batalla (GK); Ratiu, Balliu, Lejeune, Pacha; Gumbau, Ciss; De Frutos, Diaz, Garcia; Alemao. PRVW Barcelona possible lineup: Joan Garcia (GK); Cancelo, Cubarsi, Araujo, Martin; Bernal, Pedri; Yamal, Fermin, Raphinha; Lewandowski. PRVW Hansi Flick is counting on his side to maintain their momentum in the final stretch of the season, ensuring they protect their lead over arch-rivals Real Madrid and avoid a hangover from an emotionally charged week in the Champions League. PRVW Barcelona turn their attention back to domestic duties this weekend as they welcome Rayo Vallecano to the Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday.
